update.releaseNotes:
v5.8.4 - Changelog
New --- - Add support for the new `Grand Live` scenario: the bot buys Techniques and Songs in `Lessons` based on their Learnable banners, maxes the Hype gauge before each concert, performs the concerts including the final Grand Concert, and spends leftover Performance Points before completing the career. - Add 2 `Grand Live` override options to the `Scenario Overrides` page with a `Lesson Effect Priority` ranking that controls which effect categories are bought first and a `Lessons Re-check Interval` for how often the Lessons list is polled. - Add a `Start Grand Live Token Gain Test` to the `Debug` page that reads the Performance Point totals and each facility's per-token gains. - Add chips to the `Race Solver` tab that call out which `Racing Settings` are currently overriding the `Smart Race Solver`, colored by how much they interfere and tappable to jump straight to the setting.
Adjustments --- - Update game data up to `Winning Ticket (Steampunk) 2026-07-26`. - Prefer gaining a positive condition like `Practice Perfect` over flat stats when choosing training event options. - Remove the `Enable Farming Fans` and `Days to Run Extra Races` settings. They had no effect whenever the `Smart Race Solver` was on, so the solver is now the only thing that schedules extra races. With it off, the bot sticks to mandatory, maiden, scheduled, goal-requirement, and `Force Racing` entries. - Rename `Minimum Energy for Extra Races` to `Minimum Energy for G1 Pre-Screen` and move it under `Prefer Training on G1 Days`, which was the only feature still reading it. Your saved value carries over.
Fixes --- - Fix common race events like `Victory!` being attributed to a random character's name in the Training Event Summary.
